name: @rzmps/rzmps
description: 🧅 Modular and extendable particle system for Three.js

scripts.build: tsdown && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && npm run copy:static && npm run copy:declarations
scripts.copy:static: mkdir -p build && cp src/global.d.ts build/global.d.ts && rm -rf build/assets && cp -r src/assets build/assets
scripts.copy:declarations: if [ -f build/index.d.ts ]; then cp build/index.d.ts build/index.d.mts && cp build/index.d.ts build/index.d.cts; else echo "Skipping declaration aliases; build/index.d.ts has not been emitted yet."; fi
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/spatial-effects.test.mjs && node tests/conditions.test.mjs && node tests/priority-phases.test.mjs && node tests/depth-modules.test.mjs && node tests/size-modules.test.mjs && node tests/distortion-modules.test.mjs && node tests/audio-effects.test.mjs && node tests/particle-reference-isolation.test.mjs && node tests/subsystem-inherit-velocity.test.mjs && node tests/subsystem-event-looping.test.mjs && node tests/rate-over-distance.test.mjs

author: Robert May
